text: Section 1. Access Control. All systems must enforce role-based access control policies.
Section 1.1 Authentication Requirements. Multi-factor authentication shall be required for all privileged accounts.
parent_context: Section 1. Access Control. All systems must enforce role-based access control policies.

text: Section 2. Audit and Logging. Organizations shall maintain audit logs for all system events for a minimum of 90 days.
Section 3. Data Protection. Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent.
Section 3.1 Key Management. Encryption keys shall be rotated at least annually.
parent_context: Section 3. Data Protection. Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent.
